headline: NBCC secures new work orders worth Rs 28.78 crore
hook: New project wins for state-run builder
summary: NBCC (India) Limited has announced the receipt of new work orders totaling approximately Rs 28.78 crore. These contracts were secured in the ordinary course of business. The company is a public sector undertaking involved in real estate and project management consultancy.
why_it_matters: Incremental revenue growth for the state-owned construction firm.
